gen-gf-atma-fs-rowan: Atma gapes open like a pried oyster shell, its glyphs jammed close with only thin gaps between them. Rowan is the serif that does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-atomic-age-fs-rowan: A flat brush held half-turned seems to have drawn Atomic Age, its contrast sitting right in the middle. Rowan, a friendly serif, softens it with generous curves.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Round letters here get a clear channel running into them. BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, slows everything to a leisurely walk beside Autour One's bold, expressive shapes.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and stretched out, with counters that breathe. Autour One adds a bold, expressive punch on top, and the serif below stays dignified beside it, with a lowercase that sits shorter.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads traditional, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Autour One is the one to lean on for bold, expressive display, while the text serif handles generous, steady body copy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Wide, pitcher-mouthed and unhurried. Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, so a long stretch under Autour One's bold heading feels authoritative and slow.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Each character floats apart from the rest, and Stint Ultra Expanded gives the page a pipe-cleaner feel with open counters leading outward. Autour One's bold heading sits above it, tall and expressive.
gen-gf-averia-gruesa-libre-fs-rowan: Rowan reads literary and friendly, with generous openings in every curve and thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Averia Gruesa Libre is distinctive and expressive up top, while the classic serif keeps the quieter work.
gen-gf-averia-sans-libre-fs-rowan: Averia Sans Libre is plain in build but bold in manner, with light touches of expression throughout. Rowan, a text serif, thins its joins gently below it.
gen-gf-averia-serif-libre-fs-rowan: Commanding and bold, Averia Serif Libre keeps its thicks fairly mild. Rowan, a text serif, offers literary warmth with generous openings in every curve.
